column1: # The History Crossword's answers (games.js #cross): ANSWER<tab>a plain clue<tab>the encyclopedia entry it links to.
# Answers are A-Z, 3 to 11 letters, words split by a space or hyphen (the clue shows the word lengths, e.g. (5,5)).
# Every clue was written from its entry and checked; keep them short, plain and family-friendly, and never put the
# answer in its own clue. Read by scripts/make-crosswords.ps1 (which makes the puzzles) and scripts/build-pages.ps1
# (which writes crossword-data.js). Removing an answer that a published puzzle uses stops the build.
